title: React project scaffolding
description: Initialize the React frontend: Vite + TypeScript setup, directory structure (components/, hooks/, services/, types/), routing (React Router), state management choice (Zustand or Redux Toolkit), API client for Go backend, and dev proxy configuration. Include ESLint, Prettier, and basic CI-ready scripts.

title: DAG CRUD operations & graph traversal
description: Implement Go handlers for creating, reading, updating, and deleting nodes and edges. Implement graph traversal algorithms: modified DFS for linearization, topological sort for dependency ordering, and reachability queries. Support querying 'all ancestors' and 'all descendants' of a node. Used by the Linearizer and Thread system.

title: Audio Ribbon / semantic heatmap visualization
description: Build the Source Vault's primary visualization: a vertical bar alongside the transcript text that uses colors to represent semantic clusters. Writers can visually scan for topic regions (e.g., 'The Ending' cluster at the bottom). Clicking a region scrolls to those chunks. When a chunk is dragged to the outline, show a temporary 'string' connecting it to its ribbon position.

title: Outline branching for alternate directions
description: Allow writers to 'Split' the outline to try different story directions. The UI shows branches as side-by-side trees/DAGs. Writers can compare branches, merge nodes between them, or discard a branch. Useful for exploring alternate narrative structures before committing.

title: Three-pane layout component
description: Build the core Tri-Fold workspace layout: Source Vault (left pane), Living Outline (center pane), Evidence Drawer (right pane). Resizable panes with drag handles. Each pane is a container for its respective feature components. Responsive design with collapsible side panes.

title: Node-to-Query translation
description: When a writer types or locks a bullet point (e.g., 'The Hero's Motivation'), translate that text into a search query for the hybrid index. Handle both explicit keywords and semantic intent. May involve query expansion or rephrasing via LLM to improve recall. Returns ranked chunk candidates.

title: Evidence Drawer with chunk highlighting
description: Build the right pane that shows transcript snippets backing the selected bullet point. When a proposed or locked bullet is clicked, the Evidence Drawer highlights the specific chunks it was derived from. Include Fidelity Badges: microphone icon for near-exact quotes (High Fidelity) vs a different marker for LLM-inferred summaries. Optional: 'Play Snippet' button for audio playback.

title: Epic: DAG Data Model & Go Backend
description: Design and implement the Node-Edge-Thread data model in Go. Nodes are atomic content blocks (UUID, body, metadata, requirements). Edges define relationships (Linear, Branch, Jump) with optional audience conditions. Threads are virtual ordered lists of Node IDs representing audience-specific paths. Includes API scaffolding, DAG CRUD, graph traversal, and cycle/integrity validation.

title: Thread Brush tool for painting audience paths
description: A specialized tool mode where the author selects a thread (e.g., 'Novice') and clicks/drags through nodes to define the reading sequence for that audience. Painting a path automatically adds nodes to the thread in click order. Visual feedback shows the painted path as a colored trail through the DAG.

title: Epic: Semantic Vault - Ingestion Pipeline
description: Audio upload, speaker-diarized transcription, semantic chunking (embedding-distance topic splitting), and hybrid indexing (BM25 + qwen3-embedding). This is the foundational data layer that all retrieval depends on. Raw transcript chunks are immutable once ingested.

title: Visual diff for structural outline changes
description: When viewing an older snapshot, show which subtrees were added, removed, or unlocked compared to the current version. Color-code additions (green) and deletions (red). Allow the writer to 'Rescue' a deleted subtree by dragging it back into the current version.

title: Graph validation (cycle detection & integrity)
description: Implement validation that runs on every edge insertion to ensure the graph remains acyclic (DAG property). Detect orphan nodes, dangling edge references, and thread references to non-existent nodes. Expose a /validate endpoint and run checks as pre-commit hooks on graph mutations.

title: Graph-to-linear traversal (Linearizer per thread)
description: Implement the Linearizer: given a Thread (ordered node list), traverse the DAG collecting each node's content in sequence. Handle shared nodes that appear in multiple threads. Apply the stitching prompt to produce a continuous document. Support 'Full Manuscript' mode (every node once, topological order) and per-thread modes (Expert View, Novice View).

title: Hybrid indexing pipeline (BM25 + qwen3-embedding)
description: Index all semantic chunks using dual retrieval: BM25 for exact keyword matching (e.g., character names, technical terms) and qwen3-embedding vectors for semantic similarity. Store BM25 index and vector embeddings. Provide a unified search API that fuses both scores. This index is queried by the Retrieval Engine.

title: Epic: Audience Threads & CYOA Navigation
description: Multi-threaded narrative support: Thread CRUD API, Thread Selector UI with node highlighting/dimming, Thread Brush tool for painting audience paths through the DAG, CYOA Exit Widgets at chapter ends with continuation proposals, and conditional edge logic for audience-based routing (e.g., expert vs novice).

title: Thread CRUD API
description: Go backend endpoints for creating, listing, updating, deleting, and reordering audience threads. A Thread is an ordered list of Node IDs representing a reading path through the DAG (e.g., 'Expert Path', 'Novice Path', 'Deep Dive: Quantum Mechanics'). Support adding/removing nodes from threads and reordering the sequence.

title: Free-text bullet entry with tree structure
description: Build the Living Outline's core interaction: writers type bullet points directly, creating a tree structure. Support indentation (Tab/Shift-Tab) for nesting, Enter for new siblings, and basic text editing. Each bullet is a DAG node. Render the tree with expand/collapse controls. This is the primary authoring surface.

title: Semantic chunking engine
description: Implement topic-shift-based chunking rather than fixed-size splitting. Use embedding distance between consecutive sentences to detect topic boundaries. When the cosine distance between adjacent sentence embeddings exceeds a threshold, insert a chunk boundary. Each chunk gets a UUID, speaker label, timestamp range, and raw text. Chunks are immutable once created.

title: Lock/Reject UI with visual state transitions
description: Implement the accept/reject interaction for Ghost Proposals. On hover, show checkmark (accept) and X (reject) buttons. Accepting transitions the bullet from proposed state (dashed, low-opacity) to locked state (solid, high-contrast) and adds a Source Badge showing the number of backing chunks. Rejecting removes the proposal and optionally suppresses similar future suggestions.

title: Epic: Outline Interaction System
description: The core authoring experience: free-text bullet entry, ambient Ghost Proposals (light grey RAG suggestions), lock/reject interactions with visual state transitions (dashed→solid, source badges), drag-and-drop sibling reordering, and Smart Parenting that flags semantically out-of-context moves.

title: Drag-and-drop bullet reordering with dnd-kit
description: Implement sibling reordering using dnd-kit library. Support Ghost Dragging that shows exactly where the bullet will land. Handle tree-aware drops (reorder among siblings, reparent to different branch). Animate transitions smoothly. Preserve all chunk associations when bullets move.

title: Export pipeline (Markdown/PDF with anchors)
description: Given a linearized thread output, export to Markdown and PDF. For hyperlinked contexts (PDF with anchors, HTML), generate internal links between related nodes. For CYOA exports, generate choice lists at chapter ends. Support per-thread export: 'Export Expert PDF', 'Export Novice PDF', 'Export Full Manuscript'. Use standard Markdown-to-PDF conversion.

title: Outline snapshot/save system
description: Implement a version control system for the outline: save named snapshots of the current DAG state (all nodes, edges, threads, and chunk associations). Display a 'Snapshot Bar' UI element for saving versions with optional labels. Store snapshots efficiently (e.g., as diffs or full copies). Allow restoring any previous snapshot.

title: Glue Toggle slider (0-100% AI transitions)
description: Add a slider control to the Stitching View that lets the writer adjust the amount of AI-generated connecting text. At 0%: raw transcript chunks only. At 100%: fully AI-smoothed paragraphs with transitions. Intermediate values control the aggressiveness of the stitching prompt. Provides immediate visual feedback as the slider moves.

title: Smart Parenting with semantic context warnings
description: When a bullet is dragged from one branch to another, re-verify its Evidence Chunks against the new parent context using the retrieval engine. If the bullet no longer fits semantically, display a subtle 'Out of Context' warning badge. Allows the writer to proceed but flags potential incoherence.

title: Chunk deduplication & usage tracking
description: Track which chunks have been 'used' (locked into outline nodes). When generating new proposals, deprioritize or exclude already-used chunks so the outline stays fresh and doesn't propose the same idea from repeated mentions in the transcript. Maintain a used_by map from chunk_id to node_id.

title: Epic: React UI Foundation
description: React project setup and the core Three-Pane Workspace: Source Vault (left, Audio Ribbon heatmap), Living Outline (center, editing workspace), and Evidence Drawer (right, chunk highlighting). Uses dnd-kit for tree interactions. Communicates with Go backend via REST/WebSocket API.

title: Design Node-Edge-Thread schema
description: Define the core data model. Nodes: UUID, body (transcript chunks + glue), metadata labels (Expert-only, Foundation, Technical Detail), optional requirement list (node IDs that must be read first). Edges: source/target node IDs, type enum (Linear, Branch, Jump), optional condition (e.g., audience==novice). Threads: ID, name, ordered list of node IDs representing a reading path. Design Go structs and database schema (likely SQLite or Postgres).

title: CYOA Exit Widget & continuation proposals
description: At the bottom of each locked node/chapter, add a '+' button for defining 'Exits' (continuations). The author can add Linear continuations (auto-transition to next) or Branch continuations (reader chooses from a list of links). The RAG system proposes related nodes as potential continuations (e.g., 'You discussed Advanced Physics here; link to Quantum Mechanics node?').

title: Ghost Proposal rendering (ambient RAG suggestions)
description: As the writer types or locks a bullet, render 'Ghost Sub-lists' below it: light grey, italicized, dashed-border proposals from the RAG clustering engine. Proposals appear ambiently (no explicit generate button) but can also be triggered via Cmd+J or a hover '+' icon. Each ghost item shows its sub-theme label and chunk count.

title: Chunk clustering into sub-themes
description: Given top-K retrieved chunks for a bullet point, use an LLM to cluster them into 3-4 coherent sub-themes (e.g., 'Past Trauma', 'Need for Approval'). Each cluster becomes a Ghost Proposal in the UI. Include a confidence score and the supporting chunk IDs for each proposed sub-theme.

title: Conditional edge logic for audience routing
description: Implement edge conditions: edges can have optional predicates like 'audience==novice' or 'has_read(node_X)'. When traversing the graph for a specific thread/audience, the traversal engine evaluates these conditions to determine which path to follow. Stored as part of the Edge model. Enables automatic thread-aware navigation.

title: Hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval with score fusion
description: Implement the core retrieval pipeline: given a query, run BM25 and qwen3-embedding searches in parallel, fuse scores using reciprocal rank fusion or weighted combination, and return the top-K chunks. Tunable weights between lexical and semantic scoring. This is the heart of the RAG system.

title: Epic: Retrieval Engine (RAG)
description: The proposal engine: translate outline node text into search queries, run hybrid BM25+vector retrieval against the Semantic Vault index, cluster retrieved chunks into sub-themes via LLM, and track chunk usage to prevent redundant proposals. This powers the Ghost Proposal system.

title: Constrained stitching prompt design
description: Design and implement the LLM prompting strategy for synthesis. The prompt instructs the AI: 'Here are N raw chunks. Put them in order and add the absolute minimum words required to make them a coherent paragraph. DO NOT rewrite chunks. DO NOT fix grammar. Only add transitions.' Test and tune prompt variations for quality. Each output paragraph tracks which chunks and which AI-generated words it contains.

title: Stitching View UI (live-rendered linear preview)
description: Build the synthesis preview pane: shift from the tree/DAG view to a linear document view. Writer's original chunks shown in one background color, AI connector text in another. The preview updates live as the outline changes. Include a thread dropdown to switch between Full Manuscript, Expert View, Novice View, etc.

title: Thread Selector UI with node highlighting
description: Build a dropdown at the top of the workspace: 'Current View: [Thread Name]'. When a thread is selected, active nodes for that audience light up in color while skipped nodes are dimmed/greyed out. Works in both the outline view and the DAG canvas view. Show thread coverage stats (e.g., '23 of 45 nodes').

title: Epic: Version Control System
description: Writing-aware version control: outline snapshot/save system with optional labels, visual diffs showing which subtrees were added/removed/unlocked with rescue capability, and outline branching for trying alternate story directions with side-by-side comparison.

title: Audio upload & transcription interface
description: Build the audio upload endpoint (Go) and React upload component. Accept common audio formats (mp3, wav, m4a). Integrate with a transcription service that supports speaker diarization so the system knows who is talking. Store raw transcription with speaker labels and timestamps. This is the entry point for all content.

title: Go backend API scaffolding
description: Set up the Go project structure: HTTP router (chi or gin), middleware (CORS, logging, auth placeholder), database connection pool, and configuration management. Define REST API routes for nodes, edges, threads, chunks, and search. Establish the project layout (cmd/, internal/, pkg/, api/). This is the foundation all backend features build on.

title: Epic: Synthesis & Linearization Engine
description: Transform the DAG into readable output: constrained stitching prompts that add minimal AI glue between original chunks, a Linearizer that traverses the graph per-thread using modified DFS, a live Stitching View UI, a Glue Toggle slider (0-100% AI transitions), and export to Markdown/PDF with hyperlink anchors.
